purpose: An image in a fixed aspect ratio, with a fallback tile if it fails to load.

props.name: alt
props.description: Describes the image; an empty string marks it decorative

props.name: fit
props.description: How it fills the frame. Defaults to cover

whenToUse: For photos and illustrations in content

anatomy: A square-cornered frame at a fixed ratio; a sunken tile with an icon when the image fails
sizes: Ratio frames; fallback at least `size-control-lg` tall

a11yNotes: alt is required; an empty alt hides decorative images from assistive tech
The fallback keeps the alt text as its name
